description: &6STATION V&r  Assemble precision mechanisms, run one electrical processing route and network your storage.
&eWhy:&r Automated supplies, a better construction stick and the logistics the observatory will depend on.
&7- Assemble a Precision Mechanism (Create sequenced assembly)&r
&7- A storage network controller at the station (AE2, Sophisticated Storage or Occultism)&r
&7- Primary electrical route: 1 of 3 (see the branches)&r
&eUnlocks:&r A diamond Construction Stick with the replacement template, mechanical crafters, and a larger daily Supply Crate.
&7Commission it from the charter panel. This quest completes by itself when the station records it.&r
&aDo:&r Commission Foundry and Logistics at your charter.
&6You get:&r Observatory: build the lens, walk three realms, defeat two great legends and pass a Horizon Trial.
